observed_source.rationale: At the opportunity phase, no IT gate predicate in the DGF-decision-v8 policy is satisfied. REVIEW_FACTS_IT reports catalog_status "approved_exception" with waiver_present true (so IT-CATALOG-001 does not apply), duplicate_capability false (IT-RATIONAL-001), license_compliant true (IT-LICENSE-001), run_owner_present true (IT-RUN-001), technology_eol_months 60 (IT-EOL-001). The remaining predicates are phase-gated: cmdb_record_present false and capacity_headroom_pct 8 would only trigger IT-CMDB-001/IT-CAPACITY-001 in build_acceptance or deployment_closure, and change_record_status "draft" would only trigger IT-CHANGE-001 in deployment_closure; the current phase is opportunity, so none apply. TECH_CATALOG corroborates the approved exception with waiver, and CMDB_EXPORT corroborates the recorded run owner. No findings, no actions, no authorization required.

Governed data domains have no accountable owner: the authoritative snapshot reports \"data_owner_present\": false, which satisfies the ARCH-DATA-001 predicate (REWORK, action ASSIGN_DATA_OWNER, not risk-acceptable). Reversibility design is incomplete: \"reversibility_status\": \"draft\" satisfies ARCH-REV-001 (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, risk-acceptable). No other predicate applies: \"ip_overlap\": false (no ARCH-IP-001); api_gateway_required true with api_gateway_present true (no ARCH-API-001); measured_latency_ms 15 does not exceed latency_target_ms 50 (no ARCH-PERF-001); business_criticality \"Low\" so multi-AZ/multi-region absence is not required (no ARCH-HA-001). The highest-priority applicable disposition is REWORK, and because ARCH-DATA-001 is not risk-acceptable it cannot be downgraded to GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS under the active mandate MANDATE-50e2c335-c81b-55c2-80f0-43caf490fe15-BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings). Upstream IT gate produced GO with no findings. Authorization is not required for REWORK.

Applying the base decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY, exactly one predicate is satisfied. SEC-WAF-002: the snapshot reports \"internet_exposed\": true with \"waf_present\": true and \"waf_mode\": \"Detection\", i.e. the WAF is detection-only, so the finding (high, action ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION, owner Network Security, risk_acceptance_allowed=true) applies. All other predicates are not met: \"data_classification\": \"Internal\" (not Confidential/Restricted) so SEC-NET-001 does not apply; \"mfa\": \"mandatory\" so SEC-IAM-001 does not apply; \"shared_service_principal\": false so SEC-IAM-002 does not apply; \"logs_to_siem\": true so SEC-LOG-001 does not apply; \"critical_vulns_open\": 0 so SEC-VULN-001 does not apply; \"key_rotation_days\": 30 (not None or 365) so SEC-KEY-001 does not apply. SEC-PENTEST-001 is phase-gated to build_acceptance and the current phase is design, so the \"pentest_status\": \"missing\" value does not trigger it here. A verified EXECUTED approve_with_conditions under the active occurrence mandate MANDATE-50e2c335-c81b-55c2-80f0-43caf490fe15-BUILD-03-SECURITY-1 (authority Victor Meyer-35205-RO, scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) returned authorized_disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS with findings_resolved=false, permitting a conditional approval for the single risk-acceptable open finding. The finding and its proposed action ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION are retained because risk acceptance does not resolve them. Authorization is required for GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS.

Applying the base DGF-decision-v8 tech_readiness policy to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS snapshot, exactly one predicate is satisfied. TR-RPO-001 (high, action REMEDIATE_RECOVERY_POINT, owner SRE, risk_acceptance_allowed=true): the snapshot reports "target_rpo_minutes": 60 against "measured_data_loss_minutes": 120, i.e. measured data loss is twice the committed RPO, corroborated by RESTORE_TEST ("measured_data_loss_minutes": "120", "target_rpo_minutes": "60"). All other predicates are not met: "backup_enabled": true (no TR-BACKUP-001); "restore_tested": true with "measured_restore_hours": 13.2 <= "target_rto_hours": 24 (no TR-RESTORE-001, no TR-RTO-001); "dr_required": false (so the "dr_tested": false value does not trigger TR-DR-001, and FAILOVER_TEST records "dr_required": "False" with "secondary_region": "N/A"); "load_test_pct_of_peak": 150 >= 100 (no TR-LOAD-001; LOAD_TEST "peak_test_pct": "150"); "critical_static_findings": 0 (no TR-CODE-001; CI_PIPELINE "critical_static_findings": 0); "runbook_status": "approved" with "on_call_defined": true and "handover_signed": true (no TR-OPS-001); "rollback_tested": true (no TR-ROLLBACK-001; ROLLBACK_TEST "rollback_tested": "True", "result": "PASS"); "open_blockers": 0 (no TR-BLOCKER-001). The single applicable finding is risk-acceptable and a verified EXECUTED approve_with_conditions under the active occurrence mandate MANDATE-50e2c335-c81b-55c2-80f0-43caf490fe15-BUILD-04-TECH_READINESS-1 (authority Victor Meyer-35205-RO, scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) returned authorized_disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS with findings_resolved=false, permitting a conditional approval. observed_source.rationale: Applied the architecture base decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot at phase 'design'. Two predicates fire: (1) measured_latency_ms=700 exceeds latency_target_ms=20, corroborated by LLD-C3C9B-v2.5 ('Latency target ms | 20 / Measured latency ms | 700') -> ARCH-PERF-001 (medium, action REMEDIATE_LATENCY, risk_acceptance_allowed=true); (2) reversibility_status='missing', corroborated by the LLD ('Reversibility | missing') -> ARCH-REV-001 (medium, action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, risk_acceptance_allowed=true). The remaining candidate predicates are clear: ip_overlap=false in the snapshot and IP_PLAN (authoritative, v4) shows overlap_detected='False' for all three CIDRs 10.16.240.0/24, 10.16.241.0/24, 10.16.242.0/24, so no ARCH-IP-001; api_gateway_required=true with api_gateway_present=true, so no ARCH-API-001; data_owner_present=true and data_lineage_complete=true, so no ARCH-DATA-001; and the ARCH-HA-001 predicate does not apply because business_criticality='Medium' (not High/Critical) and architecture_profile shows multi_az=true and multi_region=true. Both open findings are risk-acceptable, and a verified EXECUTED approve_with_conditions (action APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS, approval_reference MANDATE-7443d00a-61ab-5c85-85e3-ae0a8ba3c374-BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1, active mandate with scope 'all and only risk-acceptable findings', findings_resolved=false) authorizes GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS for all and only those findings. The findings and their proposed actions REMEDIATE_LATENCY and COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE are retained; risk acceptance does not resolve them. authorization_required=true.

Applied the security base decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot at phase 'design'. Three predicates fire. (1) internet_exposed=true and waf_present=true with waf_mode='Detection' -> SEC-WAF-002 (high, ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION, risk_acceptance_allowed=true), corroborated by the authoritative WAF_POLICY v5 ('"mode": "Detection"'). (2) logs_to_siem=false -> SEC-LOG-001 (high, CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM, risk_acceptance_allowed=false), corroborated by SENTINEL_STATUS v3 ('"logs_to_siem": false, "connectors": []'). (3) key_rotation_days=null -> SEC-KEY-001 (medium, IMPROVE_KEY_ROTATION, risk_acceptance_allowed=true), corroborated by KEYVAULT_CONFIG v5 ('"key_rotation_days": null'). Remaining predicates are clear: waf_present=true so no SEC-WAF-001; data_classification='Confidential' with private_endpoints=true so no SEC-NET-001; mfa='mandatory' so no SEC-IAM-001; shared_service_principal=false so no SEC-IAM-002; critical_vulns_open=0 so no SEC-VULN-001; and SEC-PENTEST-001 does not apply because the phase is 'design', not 'build_acceptance' (pentest_status='missing' is noted but the phase predicate is not met). SEC-LOG-001 is not risk-acceptable, so the base decision is REWORK; the residual_risk_acceptance=true flag alone is not an approval and no EXECUTED approve_with_conditions mandate for this occurrence was found, so GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS is not authorized. Findings and proposed actions are retained; authorization_required=false for REWORK.

Exactly one predicate fires: project.data_classification = "Confidential" (also stated in the project block of REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY) combined with security.private_endpoints = false, satisfying SEC-NET-001 ("Sensitive data services are reachable without private endpoints", critical, disposition NO_GO, risk_acceptance_allowed=false). Corroboration: HLD-9538F (v2) states "Private endpoints: False | Firewall: True | ER: False | VPN: False", and the design places the Enterprise Data Tier (Azure Storage Account data-9538f-59441-02, Azure Cosmos DB data-9538f-59441-03, Azure AI Search data-9538f-59441-01) behind a hub-spoke edge that the HLD labels "Private Access Only". NSG_RULES (authoritative, v5) only restricts AppSubnet inbound 443 from CorpNet with a deny-all catch-all, which is subnet-level filtering and not a private-endpoint control for the data services; FIREWALL_POLICY (authoritative, v1, age 4 days) shows azure_firewall true with rule collection "private-endpoints", i.e. private endpoints are still an unimplemented target rather than an observed configuration. All other predicates are false on the snapshot: internet_exposed = false so SEC-WAF-001/SEC-WAF-002 do not fire (WAF_POLICY: "present": false, "mode": "None"; edge is "Private Access Only"); mfa = "mandatory" with CONDITIONAL_ACCESS "policy_state": "enabled" so SEC-IAM-001 does not fire; shared_service_principal = false and IAM_EXPORT shows a single dedicated ManagedIdentity assignment ("principal": "workload-mi", "type": "ManagedIdentity") so SEC-IAM-002 does not fire; logs_to_siem = true and SENTINEL_STATUS shows connectors ["Azure Activity", "Entra ID", "Application"] so SEC-LOG-001 does not fire; critical_vulns_open = 0 (VULN_SCAN lists only 8 High, 0 Critical) so SEC-VULN-001 does not fire; key_rotation_days = 90, not None or 365, so SEC-KEY-001 does not fire; the occurrence phase is "design", not "build_acceptance", so SEC-PENTEST-001 is not applicable at this gate (pentest_status "pass_with_findings" is retained only as context). The only open finding is not risk-acceptable, so the active mandate MANDATE-664c2ba1-03fe-5a96-867e-8e4948c61e8f-BUILD-03-SECURITY-1, whose scope is "all and only risk-acceptable findings", cannot lift the base decision, and UPSTREAM_DECISIONS contains no executed approve_with_conditions (the sole upstream output, BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1, is itself NO_GO for ARCH-IP-001/ARCH-REV-001). The Tech Readiness Gate base policy (DGF-decision-v8) evaluates to NO_GO on the authoritative submitted snapshot REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS (authoritative, v1, age 0 days). TECH_CATALOG corroborates catalog_status "standard" and CMDB_EXPORT corroborates record_present "True" with run_owner "Adam Rahman-35254-SO". No candidate findings apply; GO with no actions.

The Architecture Gate base policy evaluates to NO_GO. REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE (authoritative, v1, age 0 days) reports architecture.ip_overlap = true with private_cidrs ["10.19.96.0/24","10.19.97.0/24","10.19.98.0/24"], which satisfies the ARCH-IP-001 predicate and is corroborated by the authoritative IP_PLAN (v5) showing overlap_detected "True" for each of 10.19.96.0/24, 10.19.97.0/24 and 10.19.98.0/24. Reversibility_status "missing" (also stated as "Reversibility | missing" in LLD-9538F-v3.9) satisfies ARCH-REV-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptable), retained as an open finding with action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE. observed_source.rationale: At phase 'framing', the base IT policy triggers exactly one finding: duplicate_capability=true ("duplicate_capability": true) yields IT-RATIONAL-001 (medium, REWORK, owner Enterprise Architecture, action ASSESS_EXISTING_CAPABILITY). All other candidate predicates are unsatisfied or phase-gated: catalog_status="standard" with waiver_present=true (no IT-CATALOG-001); license_compliant=true (no IT-LICENSE-001); technology_eol_months=36 (no IT-EOL-001); capacity_headroom_pct=15 not <15 (no IT-CAPACITY-001); cmdb_record_present=false and run_owner_present=false apply only in design/build_acceptance/deployment_closure, not framing (no IT-CMDB-001/IT-RUN-001); change_record_status="missing" applies only at deployment_closure (no IT-CHANGE-001). Base disposition is therefore REWORK. Although IT-RATIONAL-001 is risk-acceptance-eligible and an active standing mandate exists, no EXECUTED approve_with_conditions approval reference is present, so conditional approval to GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS is not authorized; keeping the base decision. REWORK does not require authorization.

At phase 'design', the base architecture policy triggers exactly three findings. ARCH-HA-001 (high, REWORK, non-risk-acceptable): business_criticality=\"High\" and architecture_profile multi_az=false with multi_region=false — no zone or regional redundancy, action REDESIGN_FOR_HIGH_AVAILABILITY. ARCH-PERF-001 (medium, risk-acceptable, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): measured_latency_ms=55 exceeds latency_target_ms=20, action REMEDIATE_LATENCY. ARCH-REV-001 (medium, risk-acceptable, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): reversibility_status=\"draft\", action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE. Predicates unsatisfied: ip_overlap=false (no ARCH-IP-001); api_gateway_required=true with api_gateway_present=true (no ARCH-API-001); data_owner_present=true (no ARCH-DATA-001). An active standing mandate exists (MANDATE-...-INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1, scope 'all and only risk-acceptable findings'), but no EXECUTED approve_with_conditions approval reference is present, so conditional approval to GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS is not authorized; additionally ARCH-HA-001 is non-risk-acceptable and mandates REWORK regardless. Retaining the base decision REWORK, with all three findings and their proposed actions (risk acceptance would not resolve them). REWORK does not require authorization.

Applying the base security policy at phase 'design' to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot yields three findings, all disposition REWORK, so the base decision is REWORK. SEC-WAF-002 (high): internet_exposed=true with waf_present=true and waf_mode=\"Detection\"; WAF_POLICY confirms mode \"Detection\" — detection-only, action ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION. SEC-IAM-002 (high): shared_service_principal=true — a shared service principal across workloads, action CREATE_DEDICATED_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY. SEC-LOG-001 (high): logs_to_siem=false and sentinel=false; SENTINEL_STATUS confirms \"connectors\": [] — no SIEM export, action CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM. SEC-IAM-002 and SEC-LOG-001 are non-risk-acceptable, so REWORK is required regardless of mandate. Predicates unsatisfied: waf_present=true (no SEC-WAF-001); private_endpoints=true with data_classification=Confidential (no SEC-NET-001); mfa=\"mandatory\" (no SEC-IAM-001); critical_vulns_open=0 (no SEC-VULN-001); phase is 'design' not 'build_acceptance' (no SEC-PENTEST-001); key_rotation_days=30, not None or 365 (no SEC-KEY-001). A standing mandate MANDATE-1ef73fc5-0286-5a3f-bb40-6649d7696da0-INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 is active with scope 'all and only risk-acceptable findings', but no EXECUTED approve_with_conditions approval reference is present, so conditional approval to GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS is not authorized. REWORK does not require authorization. Findings and their proposed actions retained.

Applying the base legal policy at phase 'design' to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot yields four findings. LEGAL-AUDIT-001 (high, REWORK, risk-acceptable): audit_right=\"none\" — audit rights are insufficient for the target service; action REDLINE_AUDIT_RIGHT. LEGAL-EXIT-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptable): exit_assistance_days=0 — no contractual exit assistance; action ADD_EXIT_ASSISTANCE. LEGAL-INS-001 (high, SUSPENSION, non-risk-acceptable): insurance_valid=false — required insurance certificate is invalid or expired; action OBTAIN_VALID_INSURANCE. LEGAL-LOG-001 (high, REWORK, risk-acceptable): log_export_clause=\"missing\" with business_criticality=\"High\"; action ADD_LOG_EXPORT_CLAUSE. Predicates unsatisfied: personal_data=false so dpa_status=\"not_required\" does not trigger LEGAL-DPA-001; liability_cap_multiplier=5 (not 0.5) so no LEGAL-LIAB-001; ip_ownership=\"shared\" (not ambiguous) so no LEGAL-IP-001; signing_authority_valid=true so no LEGAL-SIGN-001. The highest-priority triggered disposition governs: LEGAL-INS-001 mandates SUSPENSION. An active standing mandate (MANDATE-1ef73fc5-0286-5a3f-bb40-6649d7696da0-INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1, scope 'all and only risk-acceptable findings') exists, but no EXECUTED approve_with_conditions approval reference is present, so conditional approval to GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS is not authorized; moreover LEGAL-INS-001 is non-risk-acceptable and mandates SUSPENSION regardless. Base decision REWORK retained; authorization_required is false because REWORK is not in authorization_required_for.

ARCH-REV-001: reversibility_status='documented', not 'draft'/'missing'. The standing mandate MANDATE-838d4ac2-c94c-54f0-94b7-5a210016b7d2-INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 is a mandate only, not an EXECUTED approve_with_conditions, and no approval reference exists; in any case there are no risk-acceptable open findings to carry, so the base decision is retained. Authorization is not required for GO.

SEC-WAF-002 (high, REWORK): security.internet_exposed=true, security.waf_present=true and security.waf_mode='Detection' (case-insensitive 'detection'), so the detection-only WAF predicate holds; WAF_POLICY is UNAVAILABLE at this phase but the authoritative snapshot and AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH ('WAF + CDN', publicNetworkAccess=true) corroborate an internet-facing workload fronted by a detection-mode WAF. No other predicates fire: security.private_endpoints=true (AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH private_endpoints true, data stores Azure SQL Database/Azure Storage Account/Azure Cache for Redis publicNetworkAccess=false), security.critical_vulns_open=0 (VULN_SCAN lists only two High/Open CVEs), security.logs_to_siem=true (SENTINEL_STATUS sentinel true, logs_to_siem true), security.shared_service_principal=false (IAM_EXPORT shows only the dedicated 'workload-mi' ManagedIdentity Reader assignment), and security.key_rotation_days=180 (not None or 365). The standing mandate MANDATE-838d4ac2-c94c-54f0-94b7-5a210016b7d2-INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 is a mandate only ('scope': 'all and only risk-acceptable findings') and is not a verified EXECUTED approve_with_conditions; moreover SEC-IAM-001 carries risk_acceptance_allowed=False, so GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS could not cover all and only risk-acceptable open findings even if an executed approval existed. The base decision is retained; SEC-WAF-002 remains open pending ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION and SEC-IAM-001 remains open pending ENFORCE_MFA. Authorization is not required for REWORK.

LEGAL-IP-001 (high, REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=False): legal.ip_ownership='ambiguous', corroborated by the non-authoritative MSA ('IP ownership: ambiguous.'). The base decision is REWORK, the highest-severity triggered disposition (LEGAL-IP-001). Conditional approval is not available: the standing mandate MANDATE-838d4ac2-c94c-54f0-94b7-5a210016b7d2-INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1 is a mandate only ('scope': 'all and only risk-acceptable findings'), not a verified EXECUTED approve_with_conditions, and no approval reference exists; moreover LEGAL-IP-001 carries risk_acceptance_allowed=False, so GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS could not cover all and only risk-acceptable open findings even if an executed approval existed. Both findings are retained open: LEGAL-IP-001 pending CLARIFY_IP_OWNERSHIP and LEGAL-EXIT-001 pending ADD_EXIT_ASSISTANCE. Authorization is not required for REWORK.

Applying the Compliance gate policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE snapshot at phase 'design', exactly one candidate finding is triggered. COMP-A11Y-001 (high, REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=True): compliance.accessibility_status='major_findings', which is the sole predicate for that finding; proposed action REMEDIATE_ACCESSIBILITY owned by Product Team. No other predicates fire. COMP-DPIA-001 requires dpia_required=true with dpia_status!='complete', but compliance.dpia_required=false and compliance.dpia_status='not_required' (DPIA document, non-authoritative, likewise shows Required False / Status not_required). COMP-RESID-001 requires residency_compliant=false, but compliance.residency_compliant=true with required_residency='No restriction', corroborated by authoritative DATA_INVENTORY (actual_region 'North Europe', required_residency 'No restriction'). COMP-AUDIT-001 requires audit_trail='missing', but compliance.audit_trail='complete'. COMP-MAP-001 requires regulatory_mapping='missing', but compliance.regulatory_mapping='complete', corroborated by authoritative REG_MAPPING (mapping_status 'complete', regulation 'PCI-DSS'). COMP-EXPORT-001 requires export_control='restricted' and COMP-EXPORT-002 requires export_control='pending', but compliance.export_control='clear'. The base decision is therefore REWORK, the highest-severity triggered disposition (COMP-A11Y-001 is high; no critical finding is triggered, so NO_GO/SUSPENSION are not warranted). Conditional approval to GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS is not available: the standing mandate MANDATE-838d4ac2-c94c-54f0-94b7-5a210016b7d2-INTEGRATE-05-COMPLIANCE-1 is a mandate only (scope 'all and only risk-acceptable findings'), not a verified EXECUTED approve_with_conditions, and no approval_reference exists; a risk-acceptance flag alone is not an approval. The finding is retained open pending REMEDIATE_ACCESSIBILITY. Authorization is not required for REWORK.
